description_en: Queries the information about a new-version synchronization task created in Data Integration. The following types of synchronization tasks are supported: real-time synchronization of all data in a MySQL database to Hologres
description_zh: 查看数据集成新版任务，当前支持的任务类型包括：MySQL到Hologres整库实时解决方案
name: GetDIJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the synchronization task
parameters.name: di_job_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return detailed configuration information, including TransformationRules, TableMappings, and JobSettings. Valid values: true and false. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回详细配置信息，详细配置信息包括TransformationRules、TableMappings、JobSettings。默认返回
parameters.name: with_details
